metadata.title: Digital Service Standards Control Catalog - Transactions and Payments

props.name: keywords
props.value: IM8, GovTech, Singapore, digital service standards, Transactions and Payments

props.name: rationale
props.value: A transaction that is not fully digital diminishes the convenience of being able to transact anywhere and anytime.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Design digital transactions to be fully digital from start to finish, unless otherwise stated in legal regulations.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
Avoid requiring non-digital interactions such as physical signatures, paper-based approvals, or in-person submissions as part of a digital service.
Implement digital signature solutions such as Singpass, and enable common digital payment methods like credit card and Paynow.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Knowing the information and documents required allows end users to assess their readiness and ability to complete the transaction before committing to it.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Provide all information required to complete the transaction before the start of the transaction.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
Information to include where applicable:
a) Prerequisites or eligibility criteria
b) Estimated completion time/time range
c) Required documents and accepted file formats
d) Cost and payment modes available

props.name: rationale
props.value: Makes long or multi-step tasks feel more manageable.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Break long transactions down into logical steps or sections.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Group related input fields together to reduce cognitive load and streamline data entry.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Progress indicators can help end users estimate time required for a task, and know their progress within a transaction or flow.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Provide progress indicators for multi-step transactions.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Use a clear and intuitive design to visually convey the process and progress.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Some transactions have long estimated completion time or many fields. An option to save and continue later provides end users with the flexibility of performing the transaction in chunks, and assurance that input can be retrieved if something goes wrong.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Provide a save draft function for long transactions.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Ensure the option to save drafts is clearly visible and accessible. Provide clear feedback when a draft has been saved and provide easy access to retrieve and resume the draft.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Pre-filled data saves end users time and minimises the risk of errors from manual input.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
Pre-fill forms with known data where applicable;
Where SingPass/CorpPass is used, provide the option to pre-fill personal or business data with MyInfo and Enterprise Data Hub (EDH).

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Properly assess accuracy and relevance of any pre-filled data before implementation.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Being transparent and upfront about payment related details reassures end users and minimises the unpleasantness of rectifying an error.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Provide payment and refund information before payment is made.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Ensure this information is easily accessible on the payment page and before the start of the transaction.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Provides end users with control over sensitive payment information.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Allow updating and removal of stored payment details in all digital services involving payments.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Provide clear instructions and confirmation prompts to guide end users through the process to minimise errors.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Clear feedback on the outcome of the transaction reassures end users.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Display a success or failure message at the end of the transaction.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Use familiar and unambiguous visual cues, such as clear copy, iconography, and colour(e.g. green for success, red for failure) to enhance immediate recognition.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Providing specific and actionable information to end users when a transaction fails allows them to quickly understand the reasons, and resolve issues if applicable.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose:
Provide the following details for failed transactions:
* a) Clear reasons for failure or rejection (unless limited by policy considerations)
* b) Alternative actions
* c) Channels for appeals or further enquiries

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Ensuring explanations are clear and as detailed as possible within policy constraints.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Transactions involving payment are important to end users. Post transaction acknowledgement serves as a secondary check and can potentially reduce the consequences of errors.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Display payment details once payment has been completed.

parts.name: guidance

props.name: rationale
props.value: Keeping users informed about when to expect a decision reduces uncertainty and manages user expectations.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Provide an estimated timeframe for the transaction outcome when it is not immediately available.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: This information can be provided before the start of the transaction, on the submission success screen, and/or in acknowledgement or receipts.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Allowing the end user to retain a receipt or acknowledgement of the transaction that can be revisited provides reassurance that the submission or transaction has been received.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Send and/or allow download of an acknowledgement after a successful transaction.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Send acknowledgement via channels like SMS, email, push notification, or in-app notifications. Ensure that the acknowledgment includes key details about the submission.

props.name: rationale
props.value: An active approach of notifying end users when they are updates to their transaction status reduces the need to manually check, and allows for timely follow-ups.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Provide notifications when there are updates to transaction status.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Notifications can be sent via SMS, email, push notification, or in-app notifications.

props.name: rationale
props.value: Allowing end users to track their transactions online increases transparency and builds trust. The ability to self-service provides a sense of control, reducing anxiety for users, and reducing reliance and load on customer support.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Enable online tracking of transaction status.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Provide clear status labels and descriptions, estimated completion timelines, and any required end user actions.
